method: Soak the dal in plenty of water for 30 minutes. Drain.
Put the dal in a heavy-based pan with 750ml water and bring to the boil. Skim off the froth, then stir in the turmeric. Cover partially and cook for 30-40 minutes, until tender. Mash coarsely.

Crush 1 garlic clove, leaving 6 whole. Add the salt, green chillies, curry leaves, coriander, chilli powder, ginger, crushed garlic, tomatoes, tamarind and 120ml water. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 15-20 minutes.

Heat the oil in a very small pan over medium-high heat. Add the mustard seeds; as soon as they pop, add the cumin seeds and, 5 seconds later, the whole garlic cloves and red chillies. When the garlic browns lightly, tip it all over the dal and cover to trap the aromas. Stir before serving.
